sql_schemas: table leave_requests | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; approved_by -> employees.id | indexes: employee_id: frequent lookups for employee leave history and balance calculations; status: filtering by status (pending approvals, rejected, etc.); start_date, end_date: date-range queries for calendar views and overlap detection; (employee_id, status): combined filter for 'my pending requests'; (leave_type, status): manager approval queues filtered by leave type

table employees | fields: id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, email, manager_id, department, hire_date, termination_date, employment_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employees.id | indexes: employee_number: unique lookup by employee number; email: unique lookup by email; manager_id: team hierarchy queries for approval routing; employment_status: filtering active/inactive/terminated employees; department: department-level aggregations and filtering

table leave_balances | fields: id, employee_id, policy_id, total_entitlement, used_days, remaining_days, fiscal_year, status, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; policy_id -> leave_policies.id | indexes: employee_id: per-employee balance lookups; (employee_id, fiscal_year): unique balance per employee per fiscal year; policy_id: policy-level balance aggregations; fiscal_year: fiscal-year scoped queries

table leave_policies | fields: id, policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: leave_type: policy lookup by leave type; is_active: filtering active policies only; (leave_type, is_active): combined filter for active policy by type

table audit_logs | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, old_values, new_values, performed_by, performed_at, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: performed_by -> employees.id | indexes: (entity_type, entity_id): audit trail lookup for a specific entity; performed_by: audit trail by actor; action: filtering by action type (APPROVE, REJECT, etc.); performed_at: time-range audit queries

table notifications | fields: id, recipient_id, type, title, message, related_entity_type, related_entity_id, status, created_at, read_at | pk: id | fks: recipient_id -> employees.id | indexes: recipient_id: per-user notification inbox; status: filtering unread/pending notifications; (recipient_id, status): combined filter for 'my unread notifications'; related_entity_type, related_entity_id: lookup notifications for a specific entity (e.g. a leave request)

methods: findByStatus(status: LeaveStatus, params?: { limit?: number; offset?: number }): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>
findOverlapping(employeeId: string, startDate: Date, endDate: Date, excludeId?: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>
updateStatus(id: string, status: LeaveStatus, approvedBy?: string, approvedAt?: Date): Promise<LeaveRequest>
countByEmployeeAndType(employeeId: string, leaveType: LeaveType, fiscalYearStart: Date, fiscalYearEnd: Date, excludeStatuses?: LeaveStatus[]): Promise<number>
findByEmployeePolicyAndFiscalYear(employeeId: string, policyId: string, fiscalYear: number): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>
updateUsedDays(id: string, usedDays: number, remainingDays: number): Promise<LeaveBalance>
